title: Isolation of High-Molecular Weight DNA from Diplonema papillatum
author: Matus Valach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb5eiq3e
materials: Examples of the DNA isolated by the described procedure: PFGE separation of HMW DNA samples extracted from Diplonema papillatum . 2 , the procedure as described, but using SDS instead of sarcosyl for the cell lysis (step #3); 3 , the procedure as described, Nanopore-sequenced sample; 4 , the procedure as described, but precipitation using NaCl+isopropanol (step #8); 5 , the procedure as described, half the starting amount of cells (i.e., 20 volumes of the cell lysis buffer added; step #2); 6 , DNA purified using a Qiagen gDNA column; 7 , λ DNA/HindIII; 8 , S. cerevisiae chromosomes (PFGE marker, BioRad).

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell lysis buffer freshly before use if high-quality HMW DNA is required.

steps.title: Harvest and Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Homogenize approximately 150 mg wet weight cells (~3×10^9 Diplonema cells) in 1.5 mL (10 volumes) of cell lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Use up-and-down pipetting with a large-bore tip.
Do not vortex to avoid damaging/breaking the DNA.
If using a lower cell quantity, maintain a cell:buffer ratio of 1:10.

steps.title: Add Detergent
steps.instruction: Add N-lauryl sarcosine (sarcosyl) to a final concentration of 0.5% and mix thoroughly but gently until the solution becomes very viscous.

substeps.instruction: Note: SDS can be used instead of sarcosyl, though RNase digestion may be less efficient.

steps.title: Perform RNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of RNase (5 mg/mL) and mix thoroughly but gently by inverting the tube or using a large-bore tip.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 15–30 min at 37 °C with occasional gentle mixing by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Perform Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL proteinase K (10 mg/mL) and mix thoroughly but gently by inverting the tube or using a large-bore tip.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 30–60 min at 50 °C with occasional gentle mixing by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Initial DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamylalcohol (25:24:1) mixture.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting the tube until the suspension becomes white and less viscous.
Centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C to extract DNA into the aqueous phase.

steps.title: DNA Re-extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase into a new tube using a large-bore tip and add an equal volume of Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamylalcohol (25:24:1) mixture.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting the tube several times.
Centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
From this point forward, use only large-bore tips (e.g., cut end to obtain 1.5–2 mm diameter).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase into a new pre-chilled tube and precipitate the DNA using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1: Add 2 volumes of ice-cold ethanol solution of 0.5 M ammonium acetate and mix thoroughly but gently by inverting.
Method 2: Add sodium chloride solution to a final concentration of 0.4 M, mix well, then add an equal volume of isopropanol and mix by inverting.

steps.title: Collect DNA Precipitate
steps.instruction: Transfer the filamentous precipitate into a new tube containing 0.5–1 mL of pre-chilled 80% ethanol (0–4 °C).

substeps.instruction: Use a glass hook or capillary for transfer to avoid the precipitate adsorbing to plastic or metal.

steps.title: Wash DNA Precipitate
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitate twice with pre-chilled 80% ethanol (0–4 °C).

substeps.instruction: Mix by gently inverting the tube several times and let the precipitate drop to the bottom.
Carefully remove as much liquid as possible using a fine tip without touching the precipitate.
Repeat the wash with another 0.5–1 mL of pre-chilled 80% ethanol.
Leave the tube open at room temperature until all remaining liquid has evaporated.

steps.title: Hydrate and Solubilize DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30–40 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH8.5 (or Qiagen Elution buffer) and let the DNA slowly hydrate and solubilize overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA by gently pipetting the viscous solution up and down several times using a large-bore tip.

substeps.instruction: To measure concentration and purity, dilute an aliquot 10 to 20× in the same resuspension buffer.
Expected values for diluted sample: concentration 0.5–1 µg/µL, A260/A280 ~ 1.8–1.9, and A260/A230 ~ 2.0–2.2.
